p1: Decide how long the game will last by the number of minigames
p2: Every minigame varies in lenght but in average they each last a few minutes
p3: Minigames are selected at random by the game
p4: Decide the level of drunkness by choosing the appropriate level
p5: Higher level gives each player more DRINKING CREDITS to hand out each turn
p6: This results in glasses being filled faster on higher levels
